entries.claim: MIMO'S OWN ARITHMETIC, built from registered entries. Clearscope: Essentials $129 / 20 Drafts = $6.45 per Draft; Business $399 / 20 = $19.95; add-on Drafts $50 / 10 = $5.00 and $20 / 10 = $2.00 if the selector's default of 10 is the unit. Rivals' lowest listed plans: Frase Starter $49 billed monthly / 10 articles = $4.90 (recaptured 2026-11-01); NeuronWriter Bronze $23 / 25 documents = $0.92 (recaptured 2026-11-01); Surfer Discovery $49 billed yearly / 120 = about $0.41 (captured 2026-07-16). Units differ and allowances beyond the draft are ignored, so this is list-price division, not value. Rival inputs must be re-checked before publishing. By Draft volume: 5 Drafts $25.80 and $79.80; 10 Drafts $12.90 and $39.90; 30 Drafts with one add-on pack of 10 ($179 and $419) about $5.97 and $13.97. Break-even: 129+5(n-20) = 399+2(n-20) at n = 110 Drafts, $579 either way, assuming add-on packs scale evenly.
entries.quote: $129 /month Start for free 50 Tracked Queries 50 Pages 20 monthly Discoveries 20 monthly Drafts
entries.platform: Mimo calculation from registered vendor pricing entries
entries.label: research-finding
entries.ambiguity_flag: Non-equivalent units; the Surfer capture is dated 2026-07; add-on unit rests on the selector default.
